intro: Gurda Wildmane proposes turning the centaur clans' hatred against them: befriend one clan and use it to learn how all of them can be beaten. Siding with the Gelkis means killing their worst enemy, the Magram, then meeting Uthek the Wise, a shaman of the Gelkis, on the edge of Gelkis Village in the southwest of Desolace.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them. We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.

If you choose to ally with the Gelkis then slay their most hated rival, the Magram. After you earn the respect of the Gelkis, meet with the Gelkis shaman Uthek the Wise, on the outskirts of the Gelkis Village, in southwest Desolace.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your two feet step on Gelkis earth. You are not welcome here!
Prove you seek friendship with the Gelkis. Kill Magram centaur. Return when the ground is wet with Magram blood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The earth speaks to me. And it says you have killed many Magram. This is good.
If you are a friend of the Gelkis, then listen. I have more tasks for you.
